environment: Actual production Edge, viewport resized from 1440 to 768 during browser-checks.cjs. Native IntersectionObserver callbacks transparently logged, no fabricated entries.
cause: The callback used only entries[0], dropping the later visible transition in the same native callback batch.
fix: Consume the observation with the newest entry.time; equal timestamps use the later queued entry. No continuous scroll listener or frame polling added.
verification: Final browser-checks.cjs repeats modal, screenshot and responsive transitions and verifies visible ticking, offscreen freeze, resume and collapsed focus. See browser-results.json.
